description:
[read-only] For one post: the same video posted again on other networks or days, and other variants of the same piece (`variant-of:`, `experiment:`, `ab:` and `hook-template:` labels), each with its per-network video numbers. A null measure means not reported, never zero.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/posts/{id}/siblings.)
name: get_post_siblings
title: Get a post's siblings
